clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: I must say, Meg and I are not real close pals. We see each other every now and again. It's like, we don't hang out for coffee. ... But when we pick up, we just pick up where we left off and it's an effortless thing that I don't think either one of us examines it too much because if we did, it'd be a problem.
clippings.title: 'You've Got Mail' Turns 25! Tom Hanks Explains 'Natural' Chemistry With Meg Ryan (Flashback)
clippings.context: From ET's 1998 press-tour interviews for You've Got Mail, republished from the vault for the film's 25th anniversary.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: I just go along for the ride. But it's like playing tennis with someone who's a better tennis player than you are. Now, maybe you can beat them if you're really on the game, but chances are, they're going to beat you. And so it just makes you better. Then afterwards you have a nice lunch.
clippings.title: 'You've Got Mail' Turns 25! Tom Hanks Explains 'Natural' Chemistry With Meg Ryan (Flashback)
clippings.context: Hanks on how acting opposite Ryan pushes him, from ET's 1998 You've Got Mail press interviews.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: I'm not quite sure really what makes her tick, and I think she kind of revels in the fact that I don't know what makes her tick. I think she protects that.
clippings.title: 'You've Got Mail' Turns 25! Tom Hanks Explains 'Natural' Chemistry With Meg Ryan (Flashback)
clippings.context: Said to ET at the You've Got Mail premiere in 1998.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: He's a very inventive actor and really, really, really tries to find new things to do for every take. He really challenges himself. You know, Nora could be done 10 takes ago, and he'd still be trying new and equally great things.
clippings.title: 'You've Got Mail' Turns 25! Tom Hanks Explains 'Natural' Chemistry With Meg Ryan (Flashback)
clippings.context: Ryan on Hanks's work on set under Nora Ephron, from ET's 1998 You've Got Mail press interviews.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: He's just beyond being a generous person, he's just incredibly generous with his energy, with everyone, you know? Not just the actors in the movie, all the crew in the movie, the people on the street.
clippings.title: 'You've Got Mail' Turns 25! Tom Hanks Explains 'Natural' Chemistry With Meg Ryan (Flashback)
clippings.context: From ET's 1998 You've Got Mail press interviews.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: It was such a wonderful experience making that film with Tom. We all loved the script, we loved the story and we loved the time we all spent together. When there's so much love on a project, it doesn't really matter if the critics don't like.
clippings.title: Meg Ryan talks about love, directing, and the importance of having Tom Hanks for a friend
clippings.context: Talking to fans and reporters after an Ithaca screening at the Sonoma International Film Festival, March 2016.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: And Tom Hanks, he was so supportive. I literally could not have made this film without his involvement.
clippings.title: Meg Ryan talks about love, directing, and the importance of having Tom Hanks for a friend
clippings.context: At a post-screening interview at the Sonoma International Film Festival about her directorial debut, which Hanks acted in and produced.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: It took [Hanks] a day to [shoot his scene]. At the end of his time, he says to the crew, 'All right, gather 'round. Listen, I know we've gotten to know each other very well over the last 10 hours together, but I just want to thank you for being here for my friend Meg.' ... It was such an act of friendship. I love him so much.
clippings.title: Meg Ryan talks onscreen reunion with Tom Hanks: 'I love him so much'
clippings.context: TODAY quoting Ryan's Entertainment Weekly interview about Hanks's one-day cameo in Ithaca; original EW piece not located.

notes: Three ET quotes come from 1998 vault footage published in 2023. The Ithaca crew-speech story is secondhand via TODAY because the original EW interview was not found.
